name: aqg-code-construction
description: Invoke this before writing, modifying, refactoring, or implementing code in any repository — the entry point for a coding task, not a review after one. Runs the 6-step code construction workflow (Pattern Mining, Behavior Lock, Thin Slice, Construction Rules, Local Verification, Self Review) with anti-pattern blockers, reviewer-objection prediction, and an evidence ledger; Behavior Lock is a RED/GREEN/REFACTOR TDD cycle, and the audit-before-commit gate sits at the end.

sentence_patterns: Run construction checks before I push
Validate the construction ledger and predicted objections
走一遍 6-step code construction 流程
Check the anti-pattern + objection block before commit

cli_contract.0: success or silent pass when AQG_AGENT is not set
cli_contract.1: generic check failure (e.g., subprocess error; D5 fail-closed)
cli_contract.2: secret pattern detected in ledger (D8 critical) — also propagated by argparse on bad CLI args; distinguish via stderr
cli_contract.4: size mismatch (declared path doesn't match actual diff; D9)
cli_contract.70: reserved usage error (currently unused; argparse exits 2 instead)

owner_only_actions: Production / branch protection / Owner-admin actions remain separate authorization gates

cases.prompt: I'm about to start writing a new feature — first follow the 6-step construction discipline
Before I refactor this module, lock the behavior and predict reviewer objections
Changing code on the prod path — first write up the anti-pattern + thin slice ledger
Validate my construction ledger before commit — pattern mining + local verification
Use /aqg-code-construction to run a ledger check
